title: Constant-preserving module pullback preserves finite type local constancy
statement: Let $C,D$ be small sites with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], topologies $J,K$, and $F:C\to D$ continuous, finite-limit-preserving and covering-preserving. Let $R$ be any commutative ring, $\rho:\underline R_C\to F_*\underline R_D$ a ring-sheaf map, and suppose for every $R$-module $M$ an isomorphism $c_M:F^*\underline M_C\simeq\underline M_D$ is given, using the genuine constant module sheafification [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $G$ is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-locally-constant-module-sheaf] and $b:P\simeq F^*G$, then $P$ is locally constant of finite type, with the same finitely generated module models.

proof.text: Choose a trivializing covering sieve of the terminal object of C. Its functor-pushforward covers F(terminal C). Pull it back along the unique arrow from any target object U, since F preserves the terminal object.

Membership in this sieve gives a factorization through F(W) for a source cover member W. Its given trivialization has a finite R-module model M. Apply normalized local transport with c_M and b to get the same model on F(W), then restrict along the factorization using overFunctorMap. The module M and its finite generating property do not change.

theorem finite_type_constant_module_pullback
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.IsContinuous J K] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (hF : CoverPreserving J K F) (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (rho : (constantSheaf J RingCat.{u}).obj (RingCat.of R) ⟶
      (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} J K).obj
        ((constantSheaf K RingCat.{u}).obj (RingCat.of R)))
    (c : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      (pullback rho).obj ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J R).obj M) ≅
        (strictPerfectConstantSheaf K R).obj M)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((constantSheaf J RingCat.{u}).obj (RingCat.of R)))
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} ((constantSheaf K RingCat.{u}).obj (RingCat.of R)))
    (b : P ≅ (pullback rho).obj G) (hG : IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant J R G) :
    IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant K R P
